items.prompt: What kind of books do you like to read?
useful_language: anything with a strong story
I lean towards non-fiction
short pieces I can finish
it depends on my mood

items.prompt: How much time do you spend reading in a normal week?
useful_language: an hour or so in the evenings
in short bursts
less than I'd like to admit
mostly on the way to work

items.prompt: Where do you usually get the books you read?
useful_language: I borrow most of them
second-hand stalls
people pass them on to me
I read a lot of it on a screen

items.prompt: Which book would you recommend to someone your age, and why?
useful_language: it's an easy read but it stays with you
I'd suggest something short
anyone could relate to it
it made me see things differently

items.prompt: What did you enjoy reading when you were at primary school?
useful_language: I worked my way through the whole series
picture books mainly
I read the same one over and over
we were read to at the end of the day

items.prompt: How does reading a story compare with watching one on a screen?
useful_language: you picture it yourself
it asks more of you
a screen does the work for you
you can go at your own pace

items.prompt: What stops many adults from reading in their free time?
useful_language: they're too tired by the evening
there's always something quicker to hand
it takes real concentration
they associate it with schoolwork

items.prompt: What would encourage more children to read for pleasure?
useful_language: letting them choose for themselves
seeing adults do it
it shouldn't feel like homework
making books easy to get hold of

items.prompt: How much has the way people read changed over the past ten years?
useful_language: we skim far more than we used to
reading has moved onto devices
attention spans are shorter
in some ways people read more than ever

items.prompt: How useful are libraries to people in your area these days?
useful_language: they've become more of a meeting place
not everyone can afford to buy books
they're underused, sadly
they offer a quiet place to work
